title: Unified path_set semantics: single-segment JSON Pointer leaf assign
preconditions: Root value is a JSON object
path is a single segment JSON Pointer (/key or key)
guarantees: Assigns set_to at the leaf key
Creates missing leaf key on write
Rejects multi-segment paths and empty paths
limitations: No nested pointer walk in v1
RFC 6901 unescaping only as implemented by each backend (must agree on suite)
